subject: Internal: MAP alignment & role matrix for Acme Retail evaluation
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MAP + role matrix for Acme Retail evaluation (internal)

Team —

Attaching the first internal draft of the mutual action plan for Acme Retail. This is pre-kickoff: we should agree who owns each milestone, confirm the evaluation criteria, and lock the close target before we loop in Acme.

Attachments: MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan draft), role_matrix_v2.csv (proposed RACI)

High-level asks:
- Review the MAP milestones and call out any missing gating items (security, legal, procurement).
- Confirm primary/secondary owners for evaluation tasks and demos.
- Feedback on evaluation metrics (latency targets, sample throughput, cost targets).
- Confirm close target week — I'm tentatively suggesting the week of 2026-08-24 to align with their renewal.

Notes:
- Customer context: Acme wants a 4-week POC with model parity checks and a dedicated throughput test. They also asked for SOC 2 evidence and data residency options — Monica, please advise on required artifacts.
- Risk: procurement will push for a net-30 (we should be ready with standard SOW).

Proposed internal kickoff: 2026-07-21 10:00 PT (30 mins) — agenda in doc. If you canheck the sheet and add row-level ownership by EOD Monday, I'll consolidate.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

---

(Inline: see the role matrix tab — I labeled R=Responsible, A=Accountable, C=Consulted, I=Informed. Open to swapping R/A for demos.)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-07-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + role matrix for Acme Retail evaluation (internal)

Thanks Neha — I skimmed the MAP and added comments in MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (column "internal_comments"). Quick notes here:

- Demo owner: I'd recommend Rohan as Demo lead (R) and me as backup (A) for technical acceptance tests. For decision points that affect cost (e.g., quantization strategy), tag Product (Karthik) as C.
- Evaluation metrics: add a "quality guardrails" row that references their sample prompt set and defines acceptable ROUGE/BER threshold or manual QA pass rate.
- Timeline: moving the close target to week of 08/17 would give us extra buffer for procurement — can we confirm Acmeontract renewal date? If their renewal is 08/24, we need signed terms earlier.

I also noted two missing gating items: external network reachability test and model seeding data agreement. Monica, can you confirm whether we require a PO before on-prem network tests?

I'll add my R/A changes to role_matrix_v2.csv and upload.

-marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.inference>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-07-18T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + role matrix for Acme Retail evaluation (internal)

Adding timeline detail and acceptance criteria.

On 2026-07-18 10:03, Marcus Lin wrote:
> Demo owner: I'd recommend Rohan as Demo lead (R) and me as backup (A) for technical acceptance tests.

Sounds good — I accepted R for demos. I added a new tab to MAP_draft_v1.xlsx called "Test Plan" with the following proposed checkpoints:
- Week 1: Baseline perf run (same traffic profile as their staging)
- Week 2: Scalability test (sustained throughput target: 3k requests/min, p95 latency <= 300ms)
- Week 3: Model parity validation (sample prompt pass rate >= 92% manual QA)
- Week 4: Final acceptance + SLA review

Owners:
- Baseline perf: Rohan (R), Marcus (A), Infra team (C)
- Scalability: Rohan (R), Karthik (C) for cost/quantization decisions
- Model parity: Customer QA (R), Redwood QA (C) — need to agree on sample set and scoring rubric

I've also added a short section on rollback/fallback in case parity fails.

I'll be on PTO 2026-07-22; if we schedule internal kickoff on 07/21, please capture any decisions in the doc so I can review asynchronously.

-Rohan
Principal Solutions Engineer

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-07-19T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + role matrix for Acme Retail evaluation (internal)

Thanks — flagged a couple compliance items in evaluation_plan_summary.pdf. Short summary:
- SOC 2 evidence: we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report and an assertions packet. Timeline: compliance team needs 3 business days to pull evidence and 2 days for any redactions.
- Data residency: Acme asked for EU region option for backup storage. If they want EU at rest, we'll need a Private deployment quote (this will affect pricing).
- Network tests: Procurement typically requires a signed NDA or PO for non-trivial network access; if they request live on-prem network tests, legal must sign off.

Action items for us:
- Neha: confirm with Acme whether EU residency is a hard requirement or just an ask.
- Marcus/Karthik: prepare a short appendix that lists artifacts we will provide for SOC 2 and the expected delivery time.

I'll add the compliance checklist as a tab in evaluation_plan_summary.pdf and upload a clean copy to the Drive link.

-Monica
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment stub: SOC2_summary.docx (summary of deliverables)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-07-20T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + role matrix for Acme Retail evaluation (internal)

I pushed an updated role_matrix_v2.csv with two small edits:
- Marked Product (me) as Consulted (C) on quantization decisions and pricing impacts.
- Added a separate owner for "SLA language" (Legal: I, Monica: C, Neha: A).

Meeting availability: I'm available for internal kickoff 07/21 10:00 PT (ok for 30 mins) or 07/21 15:00 PT if we need more time. If we aim for close week 08/17 (Marcus suggestion), we should accelerate the POC start to 07/27 (one week earlier than map currently shows). That will compress QA, but gives us breathing room before invoice/renewal.

Also attached a short pricing note: estimated incremental cost if customer requires EU storage. File: evaluation_plan_summary.pdf (pricing appendix tab).

-Karthik
Product Manager, Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-07-20T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Draft MAP + role matrix for Acme Retail evaluation (internal)

Appreciate the fast feedback — consolidating next steps below.

Decisions so far:
- Demo/Test owner: Rohan (R), Marcus (A).
- Compliance artifacts: Monica will provide SOC2_summary.docx and a compliance checklist by 2026-07-23.
- Close target: tentatively moving to week of 2026-08-17 to give procurement buffer (finalize if Acme confirms 08/24 renewal).
- EU residency: flagged as potential upsell; Neha to confirm whether required or optional.

Action items (owners + due dates):
- Neha: Confirm EU requirement with Acme; send private note with timeline expectation (due 2026-07-21).
- Marcus: Update MAP_draft_v1.xlsx with gating items and add quality guardrails row (due 2026-07-21).
- Rohan: Finalize Test Plan tab and add rollback criteria (due 2026-07-23).
- Monica: Upload compliance checklist and SOC2_summary.docx (due 2026-07-23).
- Karthik: Add pricing appendix for EU option and update role_matrix_v2.csv (done).

Internal kickoff: scheduled 2026-07-21 10:00 PT, 30 mins — calendar invite sent. Agenda (attached in Drive):
1) Quick context and goals (5m)
2) Confirm owners and gating items (10m)
3) Test plan review (10m)
4) Next steps & external kickoff plan (5m)

If you have unresolved items, please add comments to the Drive doc before the meeting. I will consolidate final MAP and send to Acme after internal alignment.

Thanks everyone — see you tomorrow.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
